verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows a built-in AI assistant in Twilio's console or product that a user can hand tasks to. The MCP server is for external AI coding agents in the IDE, which is a different story. Agent memory and AI transcription are developer building blocks or adjacent features, so neither counts toward an in-product assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
